authority: programme contract only; passing the design audit does not pass a build, bridge or physics gate

programmes.title: Shared-parent / host-channel factorization for thorium-229
programmes.observable: joint held-out line-centre, splitting, linewidth, survival and controlled-quench records
programmes.buildGate: Reproduce a released headline quantity from checksummed point-level data and enumerate any missing acquisition metadata or covariance.
programmes.bridgeGate: A shared nuclear block predicts at least one external-host record without refit and is preferred to or predictively matches a saturated per-sample model after complexity penalty.
programmes.physicsGate: A residual repeats in an independent specimen or apparatus, follows a predeclared control, survives conventional nuclear/material/detector alternatives and matches a predeclared interaction plus companion nulls.
programmes.sensitivityRequirement: Injection/recovery for the smallest recoverable host-invariant frequency, lifetime or quench residual after full covariance and multiplicity correction.
programmes.stopRule: Stop at release reproduction if event-level records, metadata or covariance are absent; stop the bridge if host and detector freedom span the transported parameter block.

programmes.observable: held-out complex ringdown frequencies and damping predicted from a frozen remnant mass/spin posterior
programmes.buildGate: Fetch immutable release products and reproduce one published posterior summary with recorded calibration, conditioning, priors, waveform version and start-time convention.
programmes.bridgeGate: A source-derived corpus operator map predicts an additional observable combination before the likelihood is inspected; this gate is currently unsupplied.
programmes.physicsGate: A residual is detector-, calibration-, conditioning-, start-time- and waveform-stable, survives a flexible comparator, repeats in another event or record class and wins after trials and flexibility penalties.
programmes.sensitivityRequirement: Injection/recovery for fractional frequency and damping deviations after the complete start-time and model scan at a predeclared false-promotion rate.
programmes.stopRule: Do not promote a discrepancy absorbed by waveform, noise, calibration, start time or environment; do not promote a corpus bridge by shared vocabulary.
